class: A background worker overwrote a value the owner had just set
symptom: Aristocrat, 29 September: the owner marked the application submitted; a minute later the still-running run set it back to 'needs you', and the run kept working on an application the owner had called finished.
root_cause: update_status wrote whatever it was given, from a run or from the owner alike, and marking an application finished did nothing to the run working on it.
why_tests_missed: Status changes were tested one writer at a time; none had the owner and a run change the same application.
fix: application_status.may_replace(): a run never moves an application that has gone (submitted, interviewing, offer, rejected) back to an unfinished status; the owner's change (by_owner=True) always stands. Marking the live application finished from the dashboard ends its run.
prevention: Give every shared record an owner-wins rule in the one place it is written, and end work the owner has called finished.
